items.prompt: Why does using global maximum 100 and global minimum 50 give a false decline for path [50,100]?

options.text: There is no legal maximum because the path has only two values.
options.why: Two positive values are a valid path.

options.text: The minimum occurs before the maximum, and the path never declines.
options.why: A later high cannot be paired with an earlier low as its trough.

options.text: The function must always ignore the first value.
options.why: The initial value participates in the prefix peak.

options.text: A fifty-unit rise is always a fifty-percent decline.
options.why: A rise is not a decline, and the order is decisive.

items.explanation: A later high cannot be paired with an earlier low as its trough.
